notes.title: Gotcha App — 32k New Users in 1 Week, $0 Ad Spend
notes.summary:
Jurre (@jurree), ex-Amazon engineer building collection apps, achieved ~32,000 new organic users for his iOS animal identifier app Gotcha in one week with $0 ad spend.

Key insight: Niche utility apps (like animal identification) have natural viral mechanics — people discover, use, and share. The full strategy breakdown is documented in the linked article.

Strong case study in organic user acquisition for mobile apps.

notes.title: Opencode + Brick — 80% Inference Cost Reduction via Semantic Routing
notes.summary:
Opencode + Brick achieves 80% inference cost reduction through semantic routing. The system analyzes incoming prompts and routes them to the optimal model:

- Simple queries go to cheaper/smaller models
- Complex reasoning goes to frontier models
- Sensitive prompts go to local/self-hosted models (privacy advantage)

Uses SubAgents for prompt analysis and Regolo as the routing layer. Applicable to any multi-model AI pipeline or coding assistant setup.

notes.title: Comparison of Financing Methods (Persian)
notes.summary:
Comprehensive comparison table of 10 financing methods from invexholding.co (originally in Farsi). Each method evaluated by suitable use case, advantage, and weakness:

1. Personal Capital — Early-stage, full control, limited by wealth
2. Bank Loan — Established businesses, low cost, hard to qualify
3. Government Grants — Specific sectors, non-dilutive, competitive
4. Venture Capital — High-growth startups, large amounts, dilutive
5. Capital Increase — Listed companies, existing shareholders
6. Murabaha Bonds — Asset-backed, Sharia-compliant
7. Leasing Bonds — Equipment acquisition, tax benefits
8. Fund — Diversified investment, professional management
9. Crowdfunding — Early products, community building
10. IPO — Mature companies, maximum capital, regulatory burden

notes.title: Llama.cpp Optimization Tool — 30B Models at 22 tok/s on 6GB VRAM
notes.summary:
A llama.cpp optimization tool that enables running 30B parameter models at ~22 tok/s with only 6GB VRAM.

Key capabilities:
- Pre-download speed prediction — know performance before committing bandwidth
- Optimal command generation — outputs ready-to-use llama.cpp commands
- Memory placement focus — emphasizes layer distribution between GPU VRAM and system RAM, not just quantization

Significant for local AI deployment. The memory placement insight is key — how you split layers matters as much as quantization level.

notes.title: Distribution 101 — How to Sell Your Products (Organic Marketing)
notes.summary:
EP (@eptwts) published a comprehensive organic marketing framework — Distribution 101: How to Sell Your Products.

Three core channels:
1. X (Twitter) — Niche engagement, value-first content, trend leverage
2. YouTube — Product education through SEO-optimized video
3. Short-form (TikTok + Reels) — Reach broader audiences with trending content

Core principles:
- 1:1 Niche-Product Rule — one niche, one product, no spray-and-pray
- VALUE Rule — content must provide real value; value builds trust, trust leads to sales
- Make every video a hidden VSL — subtle product showcasing in educational content
- Price fairly for long-term trust

Solid framework: distribution matters as much as product quality.

notes.title: Defeating AI Slop — A 3-Step Guide to Cultivating Taste in Web Design
notes.summary:
A comprehensive video guide on defeating AI slop — the generic, recognizable look AI tools produce by default.

3-Step Workflow:

1. Cultivate Taste — Build a design inspiration library from Dribbble, Pinterest, and Twitter. Screenshot designs you like, organize by type with vocabulary keywords.

2. Bring Taste to AI — Use MCP tools (like Impeccable/Taste Skill) to feed reference images to Claude. Reference images + specific prompts beat vague instructions like make it premium.

3. Iterate and Tweak — Use visual tweaking tools (Tweaks Bar) to adjust fonts, colors, spacing in real-time. Iterate visually rather than playing the prompt lottery.

Key insight: AI has no taste. It produces average, regression-to-the-mean output. The solution is taste injection through curation.

Best practical guide on human-AI collaboration for creative work.
